summary: Stability AI's developer platform grants 25 free API credits to new accounts created via Google social login; the getting-started guide offers username/password signup too but ties the free credits to Google login. API usage is billed in credits at 1 credit = $0.01, and further credits are bought in the billing dashboard at $1 per 100 credits. Terms were rechecked on 2026-10-25 against the official docs at docs.stability.ai; account signup was not tested.
claim_steps: Choose the Google social login option — the official getting-started guide says creating the account this way grants 25 free credits.
Create an API key on your account page and check the credit balance under billing.

social_proof.title: Getting started — Stability AI API Platform
social_proof.text: Creating your account with Google's social login will grant you 25 free credits! ... After depleting your free credits, additional credits can be purchased via your Billing dashboard at a rate of $1 USD per 100 credits.

social_proof.title: Pricing — Stability AI API Platform
social_proof.text: API usage is based on credits. 1 credit = $0.01. ... Get started with 25 free credits. Check your credit balance and purchase additional credits on your account page.
